about.intro: A mechanical engineering graduate from BUET whose interest in computer science grew into a second discipline.
paragraphs: I graduated in Mechanical Engineering from the Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET). I am now pursuing an MBA at the Institute of Business Administration (IBA), University of Dhaka.
In engineering I have hands-on experience designing an unmanned aerial vehicle and an air cooler built on Peltier plates, and I am interested in research in fluid and thermal engineering.
Outside mechanics I work with programming, web development, ethical hacking and cybersecurity, and machine learning, and I like the places where physical and digital systems meet.

I am an active member of scouting and the BUET Journalists Society, donate blood regularly, and train in martial arts. I keep learning, whether that is a new machine learning method or a new language.
facts: Machine learning, AI, quantum mechanics, web development, martial arts

projects.title: 2D Visualization of Incompressible Flow Through Machine Learning
projects.text: Combines machine learning with traditional computational fluid dynamics to predict fluid flow in mechanical systems. It explores hybrid approaches that reduce computational cost and benchmarks them against conventional methods.
people: Dr. Mohammad Mamun, Professor, Dept. of Mechanical Engineering, BUET

projects.title: MHD Free Convection with Joule Heating and Entropy Generation inside an H-shaped Chamber
projects.text: Numerical study of natural convection of water in an H-shaped chamber under a magnetic field and Joule heating, varying Rayleigh and Hartmann numbers. Heat transfer is assessed through Nusselt numbers, temperature, entropy generation and thermal criteria, with streamlines and isotherms showing the flow.
people: Riyan Hashem Jamy, Md Shahneoug Shuvo (ME, BUET)
Dr. Sumon Saha, Professor, Dept. of Mechanical Engineering, BUET

projects.title: Air Conditioner Using Peltier Module
projects.text: An air conditioner built on a thermoelectric (Peltier) module and locally available parts. Covers module, fin, fan motor and pump selection, circuit design, SolidWorks modelling and an economic analysis for manufacturing.
people: Shorup Chanda, Riyan Hashem Jamy (ME, BUET)

projects.title: Cooling Load Estimation
projects.text: Models a room in SolidWorks and estimates its cooling load from climate data, covering conduction, solar radiation, infiltration and internal gains. Ends with the refrigeration tonnage needed, documented in a LaTeX report.
